style: Modern Standard Arabic; address the reader directly in the second person, plainly and politely.
Right to left: never reorder placeholders or Latin words, the layout handles direction.
Generated numbers use Western digits 0–9 (digits: latn); keep codes, IDs, amounts and URLs as they are.
Arabic punctuation: comma ، and question mark ؟; quotation marks « ».
Plural values need all six forms: zero, one, two, few, many, other (one and two usually spell the number: يوم واحد، يومان).
